tools.name: cleanapp_open
tools.title: Open CleanApp
tools.description: Opens CleanApp’s interactive home panel for observed physical and digital problems, public reports, and private receipt tracking.

tools.name: cleanapp_prepare_report
tools.title: Preview a problem report
tools.description: Creates a draft preview of an observed physical or digital problem using supplied details. The preview includes supplied source context and the proposed publication and notice permissions. Report intake requires separate approval and submission.

domain.description: Physical place/infrastructure/environment issue, or digital product/service issue.

title.description: A factual short title, without personal identifiers.

description.description: What the user observed, when and impact. Do not include secrets, private contact details or unrelated chat.

location_text.description: User-provided place, street, landmark, or area for a physical issue. Do not infer user location.

latitude.description: Optional coordinates explicitly supplied or approved by the user.

product_or_site.description: Name of the affected product, app, website, or service for a digital issue.

source_platform.description: Explicitly supplied platform of the original observation, e.g. X or GitHub. Separate from the affected product and the submitting AI client; leave unknown when not provided.

source_url.description: Caller-provided public reference for the original observation. Do not copy a private chat URL, token or unrelated conversation. No URL is fetched during preparation.

observed_at.description: When the problem was observed, only if explicitly provided, as RFC3339 with a timezone. Never substitute submission time or source publication time.

source_published_at.description: Publication time of the referenced source, only if explicitly provided, as RFC3339 with a timezone. This is separate from when the problem was observed.

reporter_context.description: Caller-provided relationship to the observation. This is a claim, not verified authorship or CleanApp evidence classification.

submission_client.description: Explicitly supplied submitting AI client. This label is caller-claimed, not a verified account identity; do not infer it from the affected product or source platform.

language.description: Language of the report; preserve the user’s language.

handling.description: Include the requested publication and notice permissions in the exact preview. Obtain explicit user approval for those permissions before submitting; private review remains available.

publication.description: Private keeps the report in private review. Automatic permits an eligible public report only after CleanApp checks the report.

notices.description: None permits no responsible-party notices. Automatic permits eligible notices after CleanApp checks the report; a queued notice is not a confirmed send.

requires_redaction.description: Set true when the user requests redaction or declares private information. Omitting this does not bypass CleanApp privacy checks.

tools.name: cleanapp_report_status
tools.title: Check a submission receipt
tools.description: Looks up a report using its private tracking token and returns recorded intake, analysis, decision and reason, publication and notice status, and the next action. Results can include verified public links and related-report candidates.

tracking_token.description: Private tracking token returned when the report was prepared or submitted. Never guess report IDs.

tools.name: cleanapp_search_reports
tools.title: Find public problem reports
tools.description: Searches historical public reports about potholes, litter, illegal dumping, accessibility barriers, infrastructure damage, pollution, software bugs, scams, and service failures. Coverage is limited to existing public reports.

query.description: Specific words describing the issue, place, or product, e.g. pothole or broken elevator. Search requires all words.

tools.name: cleanapp_submit_report
tools.title: Send approved report to CleanApp
tools.description: Sends an approved draft to CleanApp’s private quarantine for review and returns a private tracking receipt. The draft retains its approved publication and notice permissions. In the recorded result, held means received but blocked.

confirmed.description: True only after the user approves the exact report preview, its disclosed publication and notice permissions, and sending it to CleanApp.
